name: lane-belt-balancer
title: Belt Balancer Planner
author: lane-belt-balancer
description: Select a gap between input belt ends and output belt starts; the mod picks or generates a balancer that fits (1-16 inputs to 1-16 outputs, plus a 1 to 1 lane balancer), routes the belts to it (with undergrounds where needed), marks trees, rocks and cliffs in the way for removal and places ghosts.
